Access.name: isIndirizzoValido
Access.Query:
SELECT case when count(*) > 0 then 'S' else 'N' end FROM CLL.CAP A WHERE A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND A.DAT_FINE_VALID = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND A.CAP_X_LOC = cast(upper(
comune) as char(40)) AND A.CAP_C_PROV = cast(upper(
provincia) as char(2)) AND A.CAP_C_CAP = cast(upper(
cap) as char(5))

Access.name: localitaCatastoAccess
Access.Query:
SELECT A.CAP_X_LOC, B.COD_FISC_COMU, A.CAP_C_CAP, A.CAP_C_PROV FROM CLL.CAP A INNER JOIN CLL.ANAG_CATAST_COMUN B ON A.CAP_C_CAP = B.COD_CAP AND A.CAP_X_LOC = cast(B.DEN_COMU as char(40)) AND A.CAP_C_PROV = cast(B.COD_PROV as char(2)) WHERE A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND B.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND A.DAT_FINE_VALID = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy')
AND A.CAP_C_CAP = cast(upper(
cap) as char(5))
AND A.CAP_X_LOC = cast(upper(
comune) as char(40)) AND A.CAP_C_PROV = cast(upper(
provincia) as char(2))

Access.name: isToponimoValido
Access.Query:
SELECT case when count(*) > 0 then 'S' else 'N' end FROM DAICREF.CCB_ANAGRAFICA_DECOD WHERE GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND TIPO = 'TIPO-VIA-INFORETE' AND DESCR = trim(upper(
toponimo))
